description: Extract structured, balance-verified transactions from a local bank statement PDF (digital, scanned/OCR, or password-protected). Supports JSON, CSV, Xero CSV, QuickBooks QBO/IIF, OFX, and Tally XML outputs.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the PDF bank statement file.

password.description: Optional PDF open password if the statement is encrypted.

zero_retention.description: When true (default), processes in volatile memory without storing the PDF on disk.

name: parse_bank_statement
